name: 19510 · Blandon, PA
findings: ZIP 19510 (Blandon) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19510 (Blandon) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19510 (Blandon) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
